title: Statuz Pending Actions
description: JSON Schema for Statuz Pending Actions — bidirectional human-agent action tracker. Both agent and human can read and write. Agent MUST read this file before making assumptions about external state.

pending_actions.description: Ordered list of pending actions requiring human attention

title.description: Short, actionable title describing what the human needs to do

description.description: Detailed instructions, including links, account names, or specific steps

assigned_to.description: Who is responsible for completing this action

status.description: Current status of the action. Agent MUST read this field before proceeding. Human is expected to update this field.

priority.description: How urgently the agent needs this action completed

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the action was created

deadline.description: Optional deadline. Agent may escalate if past deadline without resolution.

human_notes.description: Free-form notes from the human. Agent MUST read and acknowledge these.

agent_blocked_on.description: Specific tasks or capabilities the agent cannot proceed with until this action is resolved

resolution.description: Filled when the action is resolved (status = done or cancelled)

outcome.description: What happened — the value, token path, or confirmation
